central_image_original.count_statement: Seven coarse spatial writing zones around the central pointed ornament are inventoried. A finer split of sparse lower-left/left zones can yield eight or nine runs. This is a geometric zone inventory, not a word count, and no single exact fine-grained count is asserted.

zones.description: Upper-right of central ornament; one tilted run.
Right-upper side; one steeply rotated run.
Right-lower side; short sparse run with internal gap.
Bottom side; roughly tangential run with tall strokes.
Lower-left side; two sparse clusters along a bent/tangential course. They may be one coarse zone or two fine runs.
Left side; sparse marks in a near-vertical run. A large internal gap permits a two-run segmentation.
Upper-left of central ornament; one short oblique run.

nonwriting_trace.description: Short dotted/segmented oblique trace directed toward central ornament from left-lower side. Not included as a writing zone or as a full radial sector boundary; its role is uncertain.

image_ambiguity_inventory_original.description: Brown stain/abrasion over the left-lower sector writing region. Marks continue near its edges; hidden content is not reconstructed.
Horizontal fold/crease and near-horizontal drawn traces are close together on the left side of right diagram. B09 is retained with this confound.
Lower-left boundaries B07 and B08 are weak and partial. Text-block spacing and face placement suggest compartments, but are not a substitute for a continuous drawn line.
B02 inner endpoint is close to a tall stroke at the upper end of I03 and to the faint circular trace. Possible line/letter contact; no reliable over/under order.
Faint R02 circular trace passes close to or through parts of short writing zones and face margins. Local breaks prevent exact containment or overlap assignments.
Faint R01 boundary surrounds central writing, but local marks and dotted D01 complicate the left-lower edge. It is not a certain uninterrupted circle.
Central long points visibly overlap the scalloped ornament and colored wash. The overlap is graphical; layer order is not established.
Left rim and red writing approach the gutter, with faint/fragmented marks and possible physical wear. All fragments remain included in exterior zones.
Nearby parallel outer circular traces are not uniformly separated. A strict count of drawn circles depends on whether local doubled traces are treated as independent circles.
Red descenders and horizontal rule approach/overlap near bottom prose; no reading direction or chronology is inferred.

O06_followup_original.pixel_observation: O06包含真实可见的斜排红色笔迹；主笔迹粗略在x4570..4685,y1910..2100内。上下邻近红色文字也在预定context窗口可见；中间此段不是空白框。

nearest_guided_records.note: 近似框边界10px不足以支持精密断言；但整个O06红字区域仍未获覆盖。

O06_followup_original.source_locator_assignment_status: NA; only neighboring guided records listed, no glyph comparison used to assign source text.
O06_followup_original.source_sensitivity: Three files retain this red run; PDF is lowerresolution but shows its spatial presence. TIFF does not remove the stored reading-box coverage gap.

cycle_original.limit: Geometrical clockwise traversal only; does not certify complete partitions or semantics.

gate_reasons_original: Weak/contested radial boundaries remain; first reports are not forced into agreement.
Three short-string boundary differences and incomplete body-token eligibility remain.
Separated-line role and central/outer segmentation differences are preserved.
limits: Source agreement is not independent paleographic certification.
Geometric traversal is not historical text order or complete sector partition.
No per-target semantic name or uniquely defined label-specific body follows from these tables.
The six-source public record is a documentation synthesis, not another independent observer.
